title: School Timetable Maker
description: Build a weekly school timetable: set days and periods, type subjects into each slot, auto-save to your browser and print the finished grid.
howto: Choose how many days and periods per day your week has.
Click Build grid, then type a subject into each slot (optionally with room, e.g. 'Math R12').
Everything saves automatically to your browser as you type.
Press Print for a clean paper timetable.

faqs.a: In your browser's localStorage under a key namespaced to this tool. It survives reloads on the same browser and device, but is not synced anywhere.

faqs.q: Can I change the number of days or periods later?
faqs.a: Yes — change the numbers and rebuild. Existing entries that still fit are kept; slots outside the new size are dropped.

faqs.q: Does it work for college or coaching schedules?
faqs.a: Yes — days and slots are generic, so it works for any repeating weekly class schedule.
